title: Rack Runner: Daily Jot & Handoff
body:
Quick log for today (short-form) - use as my pocket handoff and future reference.

---
MORNING SUMMARY (03/13)
- Overnight: pool-az-west-2b had 2 transient GPU preemptions between 02:00-03:10 UTC; autoscaler recovered without manual action. No user-visible API errors reported.
- Latency spike at ~06:45 UTC on small-customer route (s-std-128) — traced to noisy neighbor VM on same host (PCIe saturation). Throttled the host, moved 3 low-priority pods.

PRIORITY TODOs (today)
1) Finish JIRA-4521: explicit node-drain playbook for NPU/TPU/odd-node types. Draft steps below. (due EOD)
2) Follow up w/ platform-networking on VLAN flapping in rack-17B (ticket JIRA-4588) — ask them to check switch logs 10:30-11:00 PST.
3) Trim idle GPU allocation in dev-pool-02: identify pods >48h idle (kubectl top + prometheus query).
4) Add emergency fallback route to canary config for s-std-128 (low-effort) — prevents 99.99 -> 500s when host degrades.

OBSERVATIONS / NOTES
- Dev hints: when moving pods between hosts, use --grace-period=60 first, avoid immediate kill. Saves ~5min of wasting log writes from agents.
- Batching note: many small inference jobs from test account 'atlas-dev' are increasing tiny-rps; consider adding request-size-based route to coalesce small jobs into prewarm pool.
- KV cache behavior: models with long context (8k+) show >20% memory churn after quantization changes; need to re-evaluate cache TTL post-quant patch.

RUNBOOK SNIPPETS (for my quick exec)
- Check problematic host: ssh infra-rack17b-node03
  - docker ps | grep redwood-serving
  - sudo ethtool -S eth0 | grep dropped
  - journalctl -u redwood-serving -n 200 --no-pager | grep -i oom
- Drain and migrate low-priority pods: kubectl drain node/infra-rack17b-node03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60 && kubectl get pods -o wide | grep Evicted
- Quick capacity bump: terraform workspace select shared-prod && terraform apply -var 'extra_gpus=2' -target=module.gpu_pool["west-2b"]

SHORT CHECKLIST (tick at handoff)
- [ ] Confirm autoscaler stabilized for west-2b (no scale-out > 06:00 UTC in last 3h)
- [ ] Post note to #infra-ops with summary + JIRA links
- [ ] Start JIRA-4521 PR template (link above)
- [ ] Leave comment on JIRA-4588 with switch logs request and cc: @platform-networking

HOLDOVERS / FOLLOW-UPS
- Investigate PCIe contention hypothesis for noisy neighbor: schedule perf-proc trace on suspected host next maintenance window.
- Ask SRE to add metric for 'tiny-rps' by customer to identify micro-batch candidates.

RANDOM TIDBITS (for memory)
- Aisha noted yesterday that node03 had an old nvidia driver (470.x) after last emergency patch; we should standardize to 525.x to match runtime kernel.
- Meera suggested a heatmap view in Console for per-rack PCIe utilization — low priority but will help debugging.

HANDOFF MESSAGE (to next person)
Hey — short and dirty: west-2b jittered early but autoscaler caught it. Keep an eye on rack-17B (node03). If you see repeated host-level drops, do not immediately reimage; instead drain and move pods first (see runbook snippet). Post anything you do to #infra-ops and link JIRA-4521/4588. Ping me (Ravi) if you need help with terraform apply.

---
End of jot.
